sense: shaped like a circle or a ball

phrases.english: he pulls down, builds, changes square for round (of a man who turns everything upside down)

phrases.latin: quae nunc melimēla dīcuntur ā sapōre melleō, orbiculāta ā figūrā orbis in rotunditātem circumāctī
phrases.english: the apples now called honey-apples, for their honey taste, and roundies, for their shape, turned into a perfect round

sources: Lewis & Short: rotundus · Lewis & Short: orbiculatus · Lewis & Short: globosus
